name: 1 Kings
lede: The eleventh book of the Bible, in full: Solomon's wisdom and the house of Jehovah, the kingdom torn in two, and Elijah on mount Carmel, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: Long Live King Solomon
books.blurb: King David old and stricken in years, and Abishag the Shunammite; Adonijah exalts himself — I will be king — and feasts by the stone of Zoheleth; Nathan and Bath-sheba go in to the king; assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me; Solomon on the king's mule down to Gihon, the horn of oil, and long live king Solomon; Adonijah holds the horns of the altar.

books.name: Show Thyself a Man
books.blurb: David's charge to Solomon — be thou strong therefore, and show thyself a man; David sleeps with his fathers; Adonijah asks for Abishag, and the throne set for the king's mother at Solomon's right hand; Abiathar sent home to Anathoth; Joab at the horns of the altar; and Shimei, who passed over the brook Kidron.
